name: Hanasaku Otome to Koi no Grimoire ~Guild no Nai Mura ni Guild o Tsukurou!~
original_name: 花咲く乙女と恋の魔導書～ギルドのない村にギルドを作ろう！～
source:
Lime and Sheena are dragon girls who wanted to be of help to the world and joined an adventurer’s guild to undertake quests. One day, the guildmaster asked them if they wanted to start a guild in a town that doesn’t have one. They happily accept the challenge and head off to the remote village of Erile. Along the way, they saved a young boy Ein from monsters. He tells them that he used to be bigger, but was turned into a small boy by the monsters’ magic and asks for their help in returning him to his normal form.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/12/06/december-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

New RPG in the "Dragon Girl" series, features material collecting/synthesis.
translation:
莱姆与希娜是两名龙族少女。她们想为世界出一份力，加入冒险者公会承接任务。某天，公会会长问她们是否愿意到没有公会的城镇建立新分部。两人欣然接受挑战，动身前往偏远村庄艾里尔。

途中，她们从魔物手中救下年幼男孩艾因。艾因说自己过去本来更高大，却被魔物用魔法变成了小男孩，请求两人帮助他恢复原状。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/12/06/december-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

“龙族少女”系列全新角色扮演游戏，包含材料收集与合成系统。
